recommendations.title: Migrate to PostgreSQL Free Tier
recommendations.description: PostgreSQL offers a free tier plan for small projects, which can be used instead of the paid plan.
steps: Check if the free tier plan meets the project's requirements.
Migrate the database to the free tier plan.
Monitor the performance and adjust the plan if needed.

recommendations.title: Downsize Azure Virtual Machines
recommendations.description: Check if the current virtual machine instance sizes are optimized for the project's workload.
steps: Assess the current virtual machine instance sizes and their usage.
Downsize the instances to the minimum required size.
Monitor the performance and adjust the sizes if needed.

recommendations.title: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration
recommendations.description: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to reduce the time it takes to upload and download objects.
steps: Enable Transfer Acceleration for the S3 bucket.
Test the upload and download speeds.
Monitor the performance and adjust the settings if needed.

recommendations.title: Implement Retention Policy for Azure Cosmos DB
recommendations.description: Implement a retention policy to store only the required data for the project.
steps: Assess the data retention requirements for the project.
Implement a retention policy for Azure Cosmos DB.
Monitor the data storage and adjust the policy if needed.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Google Cloud Storage Standard Storage
recommendations.description: Consider using Google Cloud Storage Standard Storage instead of Nearline Storage for less frequently accessed data.
steps: Assess the data access patterns for the project.
Migrate the data to Standard Storage.
Monitor the performance and adjust the storage type if needed.
